---


Atipicial is a sovereign Layer-1 blockchain for smart contracts, digital assets,
and decentralized applications. This repository contains **the Rust full node**:
dBFT consensus, the AtipicialVM, Merkle-Patricia state, JSON-RPC services,
and native contracts for token operations, governance, and network services.

The node validates transactions, executes smart contracts, maintains chain state,
and communicates with peers. **ATC (Atipicial Coin)** is the governance token;
**ATD (AtipicialDollar)** is used for network and smart-contract execution fees.

This node is organized as an 8-layer multi-crate Rust workspace built on mature
libraries (MDBX, jsonrpsee, RustCrypto) with every protocol-defining part
(AtipicialVM, var-int wire format, MPT, dBFT) implemented from specification.


---

## ⚖️ The Design Laws of ATIPICIAL — The Rust Full Node

1. **Real, not fake.** Every function that claims to do something, does it.
   No stubs, no mocks wearing production clothes, no vaporware APIs.
2. **Typed or it doesn't exist.** Strings lying about being integers are a bug.
   Domain types own their invariants at construction.
3. **Determinism above all.** No nondeterministic iteration, floating point,
   or wall-clock time anywhere near consensus or state.
4. **Boundaries are law.** Layers depend downward. A service never reopens a
   database another service owns. Capabilities cross boundaries as narrow traits.
5. **Fail loud, fail early.** Invalid configuration is a startup error, not a
   runtime surprise three weeks later.
6. **Performance is earned.** Measured, benchmarked, and never traded against
   correctness.

## ⛓️ Chain Identity — What Every Atipicial Component Shares

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| **Chain** | Atipicial Chain — sovereign Layer-1 for smart contracts and digital assets |
| **ATC** | Atipicial Coin — governance & staking, 1,000,000,000 total |
| **ATD** | AtipicialDollar — settlement & fees, 500,000,000 genesis |
| **Addresses** | Begin with capital **`A`** (version byte `0x09`) |
| **Genesis** | 2026-07-20 00:00:00 UTC |
| **Standards** | AEP-17 (fungible) · AEP-11 (NFT) · AEP-6 (wallets) · AEP-2 (keys) |
| **Format** | AEF — Atipicial Executable Format |
| **Consensus** | dBFT 2.0 — single-block finality |
| **Seeds** | `seed1-5.atipicial.com:10333` (P2P) · `seed1-5.atipicial.com:10332` (RPC) |

## 🏗️ The Eight Layers

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  APPLICATION   atipicial-node (CLI, daemon)  │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  RPC BOUNDARY  atipicial-rpc (~55 methods)   │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  COMPOSITION   atipicial-system              │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  NODE SERVICES blockchain · network ·        │
│                wallets · indexer · oracle    │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  DOMAIN        runtime · execution · native  │
│                contracts · state · mempool   │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  PROTOCOL      payloads · consensus · hsm    │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  INFRA         config · crypto · trie ·      │
│                storage · vm · serialization  │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  FOUNDATION    atipicial-primitives          │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
     dependencies point strictly downward
```

## ⚡ Sync & Execution Optimizations

- **Bulk archive & network import** — `chain.acc`, P2P, and RPC submissions feed
  a typed import pipeline with bounded queues, durable checkpoints, and resumable markers
- **Continuous empty-block fast-forward** — provably-equivalent native reward
  transitions applied in one bounded run
- **Engine & object reuse** — `ApplicationEngine` reset-reuse across multi-tx blocks
- **Bounded caching** — storage overlays cache reads and proven misses; native
  dispatch caches keyed by contract identity

Every accelerator must fall back to the canonical path **without changing
protocol-visible bytes or state**.

## 🪙 Native Contracts

| Contract | Role |
|---|---|
| **AtipicialCoin (ATC)** | Governance & staking. 1B total. Locked, non-spent. |
| **AtipicialDollar (ATD)** | Fees & settlement. 500M genesis. |
| **Policy** | Network economic policy enforcement |
| **Oracle** | HTTPS + AtipicialFs data feeds |
| **Notary** | Transaction pay fee & signatures |
| **StdLib / CryptoLib** | JSON, base64, ECDSA, Ed25519, BLS12-381, keccak |
| **RoleManagement** | State validator, oracle, FS node roles |
| **ContractManagement** | Deploy / update / freeze contracts |
| **Ledger** | Block & transaction queries |
| **Treasury** | Protocol treasury |

## ⚡ Quick Start — atipicial

```bash
```
# 1 — get it
git clone https://github.com/atipicial/atipicial-rs.git && cd atipicial-rs && cargo build --release

# 2 — run it
./target/release/atipicial-node --mainnet

# 3 — prove it works
curl -X POST http://seed1.atipicial.com:10332 -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"getblockcount","id":1}'

#### `atipicial-primitives/src/protocol/execution/trigger_type.rs`

```rust
    const ON_PERSIST = 0x01;
    const POST_PERSIST = 0x02;
    const VERIFICATION = 0x20;
    const APPLICATION = 0x40;
    const SYSTEM = Self::ON_PERSIST.bits() | Self::POST_PERSIST.bits();
    const ALL = Self::ON_PERSIST.bits()
    | Self::POST_PERSIST.bits()
    | Self::VERIFICATION.bits()
    | Self::APPLICATION.bits();
```

#### `atipicial-primitives/src/protocol/storage/find_options.rs`

**struct `FindOptions`** (11 members)
```rust
    const None = 0;
    const KeysOnly = 1 << 0;
    const RemovePrefix = 1 << 1;
    const ValuesOnly = 1 << 2;
    const DeserializeValues = 1 << 3;
    const PickField0 = 1 << 4;
    const PickField1 = 1 << 5;
    const Backwards = 1 << 7;
    const All = Self::KeysOnly.bits() | Self::RemovePrefix.bits() | Self::ValuesOnly.bits() |
    Self::DeserializeValues.bits() | Self::PickField0.bits() | Self::PickField1.bits() |
    Self::Backwards.bits();
```
